Questions

Personal

Can I practise at home?

Yes. It runs in any modern browser on an iPad or computer using the built-in camera. No sensors and no downloads. A computer vision model tracks your movement in real time and gives instant feedback on form and rep count.

What devices does it support?

Any recent device with a camera: iPad, iPhone, Mac, Windows laptop, or a desktop with a USB camera. Safari, Chrome and Edge are supported. We recommend an iPad (10th generation or later) or a laptop from the last five years.

How long should I practise each day?

Sessions are short, so they fit around your day. Do what feels comfortable, rest when you are tired and stop if you feel pain. Ask your therapist or doctor how much suits you.

How is my data handled?

Camera video is processed on your device and is never uploaded. Speech is recognised on your device where possible; otherwise it is sent to Apple (iOS app) or a cloud speech service (Cantonese on the web) to be turned into text, and we do not keep the audio. We store your account details and practice results (reps, scores, session times) in our cloud database, encrypted in transit and at rest, and each account can only read its own data. We do not use end-to-end encryption. You can delete your account and all your history in Settings.

Sharing

Can my therapist or family see my progress?

You can print or share a practice report from the app and give it to your therapist or family. It is a summary of the practice you did, not a clinical assessment. There are no team workspaces or clinic dashboards in the app today.

Safety

Is it a medical device?

No. Bonet is a general wellness and practice tool. It does not diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any condition, and no medical regulator has reviewed or cleared it. Ask your therapist or doctor before you start, and stop if you feel pain or unwell.
